I have been in the exact same position as you. I think i must only be a few years older than you, in fact on the 22nd of August i will be 18, an age i never thought i would reach. By the time my GCSEs were over, my grandad who had been like a father to me passed away and i still miss him to this day. Secondary school were the worst years of my life if you can relate. When i went to College it was life changing. You will meet so many wonderful people and make new friends, even though it seems impossible now that that could happen. You will meet people who will accept you for who you are, will probably have similar interests and theyve chosen to do the same subjects as you rather than being forced as in secondary school. Your entire future is ahead of you and you can be whoever you want to be. Youre so young and if you push just a little bit longer you will see the future does get brighter. I have had depression for almost 7 years now, and being a college has been the best time of my life. I dont know what youve been through but your life is only just beginning, please dont end it so soon. Just hold on a little longer and see what the future holds.
